claims.statement: Polish owners or managers must arrange annual controls covering specified exposed building elements, environmental installations, gas installations and chimneys; five-year controls add the whole building, aesthetics and electrical/lightning measurements; qualifying large objects are controlled by 31 May and 30 November; adverse events and certain resident reports trigger additional controls.

The inspection bundle spans legally distinct qualification classes: relevant construction qualifications for general controls, construction or energy-supervision qualifications for electrical/gas controls, and chimney-master or relevant construction qualifications for chimney scopes. Unauthorized or negligent technical work can attract criminal or professional liability.

For c-KOB, the owner, manager or authorized bookkeeper attaches the periodic-control protocol; GUNB interprets the corresponding entry as due promptly and no later than seven days after the control. This creates a short, responsibility-sensitive handoff between inspector and manager.

The official c-KOB is free, records controls and documents, supports multiple roles, and already provides visibility and reminders for upcoming periodic controls. It directly substitutes for a calendar, system-of-record and reminder-only product.
The 2025 amendment replaced the transition date for legacy paper building books from 31 December 2026 with 31 December 2031, reducing near-term forced-migration urgency for existing buildings.

A professional property manager's statutory domain includes financial management, safe use, ongoing administration and maintaining condition, but the concrete scope is set by the management contract. Managers also carry mandatory civil-liability insurance, including for people acting under their supervision.

A named private manager, TZO24, solicited annual and five-year inspections for about 415 Lower-Silesian objects, including about 315 housing-community buildings. It requested per-building and inspector-hour prices, paper plus PDF protocols, defect photos and recommendations, allowed monthly settlement for completed inspections, and contemplated annual or multi-year cooperation.
The TZO24 document is evidence of a dense private procurement route, not realized spend: it contains blank price fields, no award or paid invoice, and no separate software or coordination-fee line.

Poland had nearly 16 million dwellings at year-end 2024, but this is not a denominator for privately managed multi-building portfolios, eligible buildings, inspection events or routable inspection spend.

GUNB's e-CRUB exposes a location-searchable register of nearly 130,000 qualified construction specialists, used by more than 1,000 people daily; contact details are visible only when the specialist elects to publish them.

The existence of e-CRUB makes qualification verification and some direct sourcing easier, so scarce inspector discovery is not yet a defensible moat; the register does not establish inspection-specific availability, rates, travel radius, insurance or willingness to accept marketplace economics.

Przeglądy Budynku already sells inspection calendar, mobile data capture, photos, digital signatures, property hierarchy and reports. Its current building plans include a free tier up to three buildings and an annual-plan price of PLN 1,750 net per month for up to 30 buildings, equal to PLN 700 per building per year at full utilization.

Figure advertises multi-specialty, same-visit inspection delivery with PLN 2.5 million liability cover. Its general-building prices start at PLN 300 net per object for annual/half-year scopes in larger portfolios and PLN 400 for five-year scopes, versus PLN 700 and PLN 800 respectively for one or two objects.

Using Figure's larger-package asking prices, one annual plus one-fifth of a five-year general-building scope normalizes to PLN 380 per building-year; a 15% dispatch fee would yield only PLN 57 per building-year before coordination, QA, rework, insurance or acquisition costs. This excludes gas, chimney, electrical and other scopes whose portfolio prices were not established.

Mediatis already markets nationwide portfolio coverage, coordination of multiple specialist types, annual/five-year/half-year and installation controls, protocols, defect recommendations, its own inspection app, and KOB/c-KOB assistance. This closely matches the proposed managed network rather than merely the software layer.

In a housing-community case, UODO held the community to be the personal-data controller and its contracted administrator to be an Article 28 processor. A new platform acting for that manager would therefore likely be a processor or subprocessor for personal data and could not assume unrestricted reuse rights.

No sourced evidence establishes that private managers will pay a separate PLN 600-per-building recurring fee plus a 15% dispatch fee after accounting for free c-KOB and existing software/service incumbents.

No verified, scalable list of private Polish managers with portfolio size, geography and procurement authority was found; one reachable 415-object buyer does not establish channel economics or a representative distribution.
Regional accept rates, day rates, travel limits, insurance, seasonal capacity and protocol-rework rates for each required inspector specialty remain unmeasured.

No public c-KOB integration API, commercial integration terms or supported bulk-write pathway was verified in the official materials reviewed; the candidate must assume role-based/manual operation until GUNB confirms otherwise.

A nationwide dispatch promise would combine multi-specialty credential checks, travel scheduling, short c-KOB/protocol handoffs, defect escalation, rework and liability. That operating profile is unlikely to fit a solo founder's part-time schedule without a narrow region and volume cap.

At the explicit test economics below, reaching PLN 5 million founder net worth requires roughly 7,000 retained buildings and about 70 managers of 100 buildings each by year 9; neither acquisition scale nor operating capacity is evidenced.

contrary_evidence: The official c-KOB is free and already provides records, role access and reminders for upcoming inspections, directly substituting for calendar-only value.
Legacy paper KOB transition was extended to 31 December 2031, removing the previously imminent migration deadline for existing books.
Przeglądy Budynku already offers the core inspection-software functions, a free small-portfolio tier and a published 30-building annual-plan price.
Figure already bundles qualified specialties, same-visit delivery, protocols and PLN 2.5 million liability cover at low published portfolio starting prices.
Mediatis already provides nationwide multi-specialty dispatch, coordination, its own app, documentation and KOB/c-KOB help to portfolio customers.
e-CRUB makes nearly 130,000 qualified construction specialists publicly searchable by location, weakening a simple verification or directory moat.
The private TZO24 solicitation budgets inspection services per building and inspector-hour but contains no separate software or coordination-fee budget and no disclosed award price.
UODO's controller-processor allocation means personal-data reuse cannot be assumed; defect-photo, protocol and building-data reuse also needs contractual analysis.

unknowns: Actual paid private-manager spend per building across general, gas, chimney, electrical, lightning and event-driven scopes, including its distribution by portfolio size and region.
Which managers' contracts let them select and route inspectors or buy a recurring platform without a separate community, owner or board authorization.
A scalable, lawful and current list of private manager portfolios with building count, geography, contact and procurement timing.
The annual distribution and seasonality of inspection scopes per eligible building, including the share of large and event-triggered objects.
Inspector accept rates, rates, travel radius, professional-insurance limits and peak-period capacity by required specialty.
Whether GUNB offers a supported c-KOB API, bulk import or partner integration, and what authorization and liability terms apply.
First-pass protocol completeness, technical QA boundaries, rework cost and liability allocation between platform, manager and signing inspector.
Willingness to pay the proposed recurring fee and dispatch margin after comparison with free c-KOB, standalone software and full-service incumbents.
Ownership and reuse rights for protocols, defect photos, remediation records, commercial building data and derived benchmarks, distinct from personal data.
Actual sales hours, onboarding effort, renewal, churn and portfolio contraction for private-manager accounts.
The founder's true part-time capacity during May and November peaks and the building count at which an operations hire becomes mandatory.
